description: Implementation of BufferNULL class methods for null renderer in ANGLE project, managing buffer data in a null (no-op) context.

classes.name: BufferNULL
classes.description: A null implementation of a buffer object for the ANGLE graphics library.

methods.name: BufferNULL
methods.description: Constructor initializing BufferNULL with buffer state and allocation tracker.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets buffer data, updating memory allocation.

methods.name: setSubData
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data.

methods.name: copySubData
methods.description: Copies data from another buffer into this buffer.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps entire buffer data for access.

methods.name: mapRange
methods.description: Maps a range of buffer data for access.
